verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official, documented CLI (`supabase init`/`supabase start`) that runs the full stack locally or in CI. Hands-on probes confirm it installs via npx, runs headlessly, and scaffolds a project with no login or key, so an agent can drive it from a script. Agent-relevant extras include `supabase db advisors`, a local MCP endpoint served by the CLI, env-var telemetry opt-out, and a CLI-specific llms.txt corpus. Community reports of frequent releases and local-dev bugs are not concrete contradictions of the capability. Missing for 10: evidence of structured/JSON output modes for agent parsing, and documentation of remote project-management commands (login, link, deploy) for headless use.
